questions.question: Big institutions asked for 14.1x the shares kept for them. Why do people watch this figure?

choices.text: Professionals who studied the company closely are showing how keen they are.
It guarantees the share price will rise on listing day.
It tells you how many shares you will be given.

questions.explanation: Institutions do the most homework, and they asked for 14.1x their quota of R.K. Fashion Accessories Limited: strong appetite. Still, no figure guarantees a listing gain.

numbers.name: qib_x
numbers.label: Times big institutions' shares were asked for

questions.question: An unofficial grey market premium of ₹1.50 a share is being quoted. How much should you rely on it?

choices.text: Completely: it tells you the listing price.
A little at most: it is unregulated and easy to push around.
It is set by the stock exchange.

questions.explanation: The grey market premium of ₹1.50 for R.K. Fashion Accessories Limited is gossip with a number on it: nobody regulates it, and it often turns out wrong.

note: Only a few questions could be written: most of the figures they need haven't been read from the RHP yet.
